title: Computing Igusa's local zeta function of univariates in deterministic polynomial-time
relevant_concepts: closed form for the number of roots mod p^k
notes: docs/theory/padic_lifting_trees.md. Elementary proof of rationality for univariate f, with a closed form for N_k(f) once k >= k0 = O(d^2 (log C + log d)); N_k is constant beyond k0 when the discriminant is nonzero. The project's finite-horizon determinacy is a local, per-node statement and does not improve this global bound.
